## Activity

During February 2023, Market Eye Clinic recorded 355 captures. Activity was completed as planned, with session lists proceeding as scheduled apart from routine leave. The reported capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. No further adjustment to the activity total is indicated in the site report.

## Image quality

There were 14 ungradable captures during the reporting period. The ungradable rate was 3.9 per cent. This result is presented alongside the overall capture activity to support routine monitoring of image quality at Market Eye Clinic. The ungradable captures remain part of the reported activity total and are considered separately from images suitable for grading.

## Grading

A total of 69 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. These figures provide the monthly summary of grading activity and turnaround for Market Eye Clinic. The referable result count and median lag should be considered with the capture volume and image-quality findings when reviewing site operations for February 2023.
